title: An Unforgettable, Fanciful Experience.
text: 10/15/26: When we learned that our Catholic Pilgrimage with Glimmer Tours did NOT include the interior of La Sagrada Família, we decided to take action. Several weeks prior to our visit we booked our 90 minute “Fast Track” interior tour with an English-speaking guide through Expedia. Even then it was difficult finding an available tour because of the popularity of this famed Basilica. We met our exceptional local guide Jose across the street at Julia Travel for our 2PM tour. author: markvM7279ZC

title: Fantastic tour
text: This was excellent!!! Our guide was raised in Barcelona and was so knowledgeable about the cathedral. She had photos to share of the construction process and her passion and excitement and insider info really made the tour a complete experience. Highly recommend!
author: Kristina_J

title: Sold full tour of 1.5hr at the Cadetral, but only offers 30 minutes on the ground floor
text: The Cathedral is beautiful, but the service provided by the agency Julia Travel was terrible, because we hired a complete visit, with the towers, with a duration of 1.5hrs and offered us only about 30 minutes on the ground floor, and the guide spoke in advance, whoever wants, can return to the agency and complain, that was what we did, but so far, the answers are getting rid of responsibilities without wanting to compensate for our frustrations, which I understand is an unquestionable right
author: A4656BRmarcos

title: Very Good
text:
Our guide Roger was very informative! 
We loved hearing all of the historical information about the Cathedral. I would totally recommend this tour!
author: Susan_J

title: Sagrada and Roger, made our entire vacation!
text:
Roger with Julia Travel was truly an amazingly engaging, articulate, and knowledgeable historian/guide. His details and ability to tell the story stood out about one of our favorite European tours only made the Sagrada Familia basilica that much more impressive.
Every one of us was blown away with the tour, but also Roger. I would not recommend using anyone only because I doubt there is anyone with his energy, attention to detail, and authentic love for the Sagrada. Thank you Julia Travel, you owe Roger some significant recognition. We’re telling everyone!
author: K8111AMjasonh

title: Wonderful guide
text: We love Anna. She was wonderful and full of information. She delivered the information in an exciting and captivating way. I would totally recommend this private tour. The meeting place was close to the church and the walk was very short. Very good for my mother with a bad knee. Anna walked according to our pace and we never felt rush.  She was also responsive on Whatsapp.
author: darwin_a

title: A wonderful tour with a wonderful person
text: We had a memorable experience thanks to our guide Ann (I hope I spelled her name correctly). She was so knowledgeable about the construction, design, meaning, and history of this amazing cathedral. She was such a wonderful person, and we feel we were so lucky to have had her as our guide. We highly recommend this service for your tour in Barcelona.
author: Scott_N

title: Miguel was the best tour guide we have ever had!
text: Miguel was an INCREDIBLE guide - he was energetic, his English was perfect and easy to understand (without having to use a headset!), and he is passionate about teaching others about Barcelona and the Sagrada Familia! He even used a whiteboard to illustrate the growth of the city over time, the various scenes on the facade, etc. I cannot say enough good things about Miguel's Sagrada Familia tour!
author: Bridget_G
